etymologies.etymologyHTML: Learned borrowing from Latin commemorātus.

definitions.definition: (transitive) To honour the memory of someone or something with a ceremony or object.

quote.citation: 2009, Naava Piatka, No Goodbyes: A Father-Daughter Memoir of Love, War and Resurrection, page 98:
quote.text: On the anniversary of Korczak's murder, Israel commemorated him with a special postal issue. As a stamp collector and philatelic columnist, it pleased me greatly when other countries followed Israel's example in honoring him.

definitions.definition: (transitive) To serve as a memorial to someone or something.
